mapper.select: INSERT INTO device_shadow (device_id, tenant_id, desired, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{tenantId}, jsonb_strip_nulls(CAST(#{delta} AS JSONB)), 1, now()) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, desired = jsonb_strip_nulls(COALESCE(device_shadow.desired, '{}'::jsonb) || CAST(#{delta} AS JSONB)), version = device_shadow.version + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING device_id AS deviceId, tenant_id AS tenantId, desired::text AS desired, version, updated_at AS updatedAt

INSERT INTO device_shadow (device_id, tenant_id, desired, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{tenantId}, CAST(#{desired} AS JSONB), 1, now()) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, desired = EXCLUDED.desired, version = device_shadow.version + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING device_id AS deviceId, tenant_id AS tenantId, desired::text AS desired, version, updated_at AS updatedAt
SELECT device_id AS deviceId, tenant_id AS tenantId, desired::text AS desired, version, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM device_shadow WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
